d:
Psoriasis and eczema can cause recurring itching, redness, dryness, scaling and skin irritation. Managing these conditions requires patience, gentle skincare and attention to possible triggers. A consistent routine can help support skin comfort and overall well-being.
In this video, Hansaji shares a simple 21-day natural skin-care protocol divided into three stages: calm and clear, soothe and repair, and nourish and protect.
You will learn about:
1. How a lukewarm oatmeal bath can soothe dry, itchy skin.
2. Using coconut oil or sesame oil to soften dry skin and support the skin barrier.
